title: Drive Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 132bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Feet shoulder width
Knees soft low
Paddle in front
Eyes on the seam

[Whisper verse]
Weight back to front
Hip turn first
Shoulder follows hip
Paddle stays quiet

Contact out front
Waist height window
Level swing path
Flat face square

[Tribal drop chant]
Drive the line drive the line
Low to mid low to mid
Vamos firme vamos firme
Drive the line drive the line

[Whisper verse]
Grip pressure four out of ten
Wrist stays still
Elbow leads the swing
Finish at the shoulder

Follow through points to the target
Return to ready
Split step on their swing
Reset breath one two

[Tribal drop chant]
Drive the line drive the line
Low to mid low to mid
Vamos firme vamos firme
Drive the line drive the line

[Whisper outro]
Quiet hands
Loud feet
Quiet hands
Loud feet
